transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you, too. 

I'm here because I've been having some trouble with my eating habits lately. After some really long days on the construction site, or sometimes after a neighborhood meeting, I’ll come home and just eat way more than I ever meant to. I'll go through leftover takeout, bowls of cereal, chips—really whatever’s there in the kitchen. I just kind of keep going until I’m uncomfortably full. It's been bothering me enough that I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
After these episodes of overeating, do you do anything to try to prevent weight gain, such as vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

Well, yeah, I do. Um, not every time, but maybe a few times a month after one of those nights, I've gone into the bathroom and made myself throw up. I just get this sudden panic about undoing all the work I’ve put into looking put-together. So, yes, I have done that.
